component.name: Postern
component.summary: Proton Mail for your AI apps, safely

description.p: Postern is an MCP server for Proton Mail. It lets Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, Codex, VS Code, Gemini CLI and other AI apps read, sort, draft and send your Proton Mail through Proton Mail Bridge, within the limits you set.

It treats the AI app itself as a suspect: every tool is off until you turn it on, nothing leaves without your approval in Postern's window and your password or fingerprint, and emails are cleaned of hidden instructions before an app reads them.
Postern is an independent open-source project, not affiliated with Proton AG.
Postern for Linux, with polkit approvals, the desktop's keyring and a jailed message reader.
